headline: Iran has DETAILED PLANS to hit Gulf undersea cables and will try to PREVENT REPAIRS to prolong the blackout
dek: Tehran has drawn up detailed plans to target undersea communications cables in the Gulf if the US and Israel attack Iran again. One official said Iran would aim to prevent repairs after any attacks to prolong disruptions to communications and internet.
sources: Two senior Iranian security officials, speaking to Reuters on condition of anonymity; TeleGeography research director Alan Mauldin; Alex Vatanka (Middle East Institute)
fault_line: Is the cable threat real deterrence or a bluff — and who pays if the Gulf's banks, payments and cloud go dark: Tehran or Washington?
